title: 练习二（2024年）

41.why: “做事一度不认真” means he was not taking his duties seriously. 敷衍 fits this careless attitude.

options.label: A
options.zh: 骄傲，看不起别人
options.note: Being proud is different from doing a job carelessly.

options.label: B
options.zh: 做事不认真，只求应付过去
options.note: Use: 敷衍了事. It matches “不认真”.

options.label: C
options.zh: 冷淡，不关心
options.note: Focuses on lack of interest or concern, not careless work.

options.label: D
options.zh: 态度坚决，不肯让步
options.note: Refusing to give way is not the clue here.

42.why: 幸亏 introduces the help that prevented a bad result: 杰成 reached out and saved him.

options.label: A
options.zh: 多亏某种有利条件，才避免坏结果
options.note: Use: 幸亏有人帮忙. It can introduce a whole clause.

options.label: B
options.zh: 幸运地免于灾难或损失
options.note: Use: 幸免于难. It cannot introduce “杰成伸手拉了他” here.

options.label: C
options.zh: 不幸运；令人难过的事情
options.note: The rescue is good fortune, not bad luck.

options.label: D
options.zh: 因偶然的有利条件而免于不幸或获得成功
options.note: Use: 侥幸脱险. Here the clause names the person whose help saved him.

43.why: The question “为什么……” shows that 杰成 does not understand the different actions.

options.label: A
options.zh: 说话温和曲折，不直接
options.note: Describes how something is said, not a puzzled feeling.

options.label: B
options.zh: 认为不值得；轻视
options.note: Nothing shows that he looks down on the explanation.

options.label: C
options.zh: 因突然的刺激而害怕
options.note: The question shows puzzlement, not fear.

options.label: D
options.zh: 不明白，心中有疑问
options.note: Use: 疑惑地问. It matches his question.

44.why: “刻在心灵的深处” means keeping a memory permanently. 永不磨灭 means it will never fade away.

options.label: A
options.zh: 对过去的人或事深切地想念
options.note: “永不怀念” would mean never remembering fondly—the opposite idea.

options.label: B
options.zh: 逐渐消失；因时间等而失去痕迹
options.note: Use: 不可磨灭的记忆.

options.label: C
options.zh: 使敌人、有害事物等不再存在
options.note: Use: 消灭害虫. Not the natural word for a lasting memory here.

options.label: D
options.zh: 赶走人或动物
options.note: Use: 驱赶蚊虫. A memory is not physically chased away.

45.why: The passage contrasts a forgiving attitude with being fussy about every small matter.

options.label: A
options.zh: 在行家面前卖弄本领
options.note: About showing off skills, not forgiveness.

options.label: B
options.zh: 只求勉强过得去，不求进步
options.note: About lack of effort, not counting every small wrong.

options.label: C
options.zh: 对小事或小利过分计较
options.en: be petty; fuss over small matters
options.note: It contrasts with “宽容的胸怀”.

options.label: D
options.zh: 为达目的，什么手段都使用
options.en: use any means to reach a goal
options.note: The passage is not about achieving a goal by any means.

46.why: The natural phrase is 陷入僵局: become stuck in a situation with no progress.

options.label: A
options.zh: 事物发展的方向
options.note: A noun, not the verb needed before “僵局”.

options.label: B
options.zh: 从高处往下掉
options.note: Usually describes a physical fall.

options.label: C
options.zh: 落到较差的处境或地位
options.note: Use: 沦落街头. Not the normal pairing with “僵局”.

options.label: D
options.zh: 落入不利处境，难以脱身
options.note: Use: 陷入困境、陷入僵局.

47.why: The next words are “感谢他人……的帮助”. They explain what a 感恩的心 means.

options.label: A
options.zh: 受到触动而产生情感
options.note: A feeling caused by an event; not specifically thankfulness.

options.label: B
options.zh: 有感触而怀念
options.note: Focuses on remembering with emotion.

options.label: C
options.zh: 因有所感触而产生复杂的情绪
options.note: May include many feelings, not just gratitude.

options.label: D
options.zh: 感谢别人给予的帮助或恩惠
options.note: Use: 常怀感恩之心.

48.why: The passage asks us to forgive friends' mistakes. 过失 names those mistakes, not a lack of ability.

options.label: A
options.zh: 较不利或较弱的地位、情况
options.note: A disadvantage is not a mistake to forgive.

options.label: B
options.zh: 测量值或计算结果与真实值的差别
options.note: Usually used in measurement or calculation.

options.label: C
options.zh: 因疏忽等造成的错误
options.note: Use: 宽容别人的过失.

options.label: D
options.zh: 能力或条件中较弱的一方面
options.note: A weakness is different from doing something wrong.

49.why: “刻在心灵的深处” and “永不磨灭” point to remembering deeply: 铭记.

options.label: A
options.zh: 心里牵挂，放心不下
options.note: Use: 惦记家人. Focuses on concern.

options.label: B
options.zh: 深深地记在心里
options.note: Use: 铭记恩情. Matches the image of carving a lasting memory.

options.label: C
options.zh: 把事情写下来或用其他方式保存
options.note: Focuses on recording information, not remembering deeply.

options.label: D
options.zh: 记住或回想；也指记住的内容
options.note: A general memory word; 铭记 better expresses lasting gratitude here.

50.why: 真心对待朋友 means treating friends sincerely. It fits the message about friendship.

options.label: A
options.zh: 以某种态度处理人或事
options.note: Use: 真心对待朋友.

options.label: B
options.zh: 照料别人的生活需要
options.note: Friendship here is not about serving someone's daily needs.

options.label: C
options.zh: 为别人或社会提供帮助、便利
options.note: Use: 为顾客服务. Not the intended relationship here.

options.label: D
options.zh: 设法处理；也可指不认真地敷衍
options.note: The passage calls for sincerity, not merely getting by.

paragraphs: 两个死党——国华和杰成一起参加学校主办的爬山活动。在途中，身为队长的国华做事一度不认真，态度{41}。杰成看不过眼，在一次争执中给了国华一记耳光。国华在沙子上写下：“今天我的好朋友打了我一巴掌。”
他们接着往上爬，国华差点儿失足跌下山崖，{42}杰成伸手拉了他一把，救了他。被救上来后，国华拿起一把小刀在石头上刻下：“今天我的好朋友救了我一命。”
杰成{43}地问：“为什么我打了你以后你要写在沙子上，而救了你以后却刻在石头上呢？”
国华说：“当我们被朋友伤害时，要写在易忘的地方，风会负责抹去它；当我们得到他人的帮助时，要把它刻在心灵的深处，让它永不{44}。”
朋友之间，难免会面对友情的考验。如果我们没有宽容的胸怀，凡事{45}，那么朋友就会离我们而去，这会使自己的人际关系{46}僵局。
若我们常怀一颗{47}的心，感谢他人在平凡生活中的点滴帮助；若我们能够宽以待人，宽容朋友的某些{48}，那么我们也就会时时得到朋友的关怀与帮助。
有位哲人说：记住该记住的，忘记该忘记的！我想，那些善良美好的事物，我们应该{49}；那些丑陋和不愉快的体验，我们应该学会忘记。真心{50}你的朋友，你将会得到真心的朋友！
